title: Lesson v1
description: One lesson a unit retro produced. Changed only through scripts/lessons; the audit trail is the append-only, hash-chained <slug>.audit.jsonl next to it (contracts/lessons/audit.v1.json) (D-069 items 4 and 9).

id.description: lessons.id_prefix plus the dedup hash of (source unit, source ref, title).

slug.description: The file name, derived from the title and the id.

title.description: One line that names the problem.

unit.description: The unit whose retro found it.

retro.description: Where it was read: a retro path or "pr-comment:<n>".

section.description: Retro section number (1 brief, 2 audit and plan, 3 execution, 4 gate, 5 lessons).

ref.description: The item inside the section: a table id (F5) or a list number (L2).

kind.description: Kind of change, one of lessons.kinds.

change.description: The concrete change that would have prevented it: a rule, brief template, config, tool, shared helper or check.

area.description: Path globs or unit ids the lesson is about; scripts/lessons for-area matches a unit area against them.

event.description: Event type in the log that counts as one occurrence, e.g. gate.failed.

stage.description: Gate stage the occurrence is in; null for any.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against the failing test ids and signatures of the event; null for any.

signals.description: What an occurrence of the class looks like in the event log; the effect is measured by counting them before and after the lesson was applied.

ref.description: The merge commit, file or command that carries the change.

before.description: Occurrences of the signals in the window before applied.at.

after.description: Occurrences in the window after applied.at.

level.description: Where the lesson applies, one of lessons.levels (commit, pr, program, venture). Optional: a record without it is read as lessons.default_level.

padrao_candidate.description: True when the lesson applies to every venture and is to be lifted later into the central Padrão in A Torre. Optional, false when absent. Nothing lifts it yet.
